In HTML, what are the html tags?: root element that contains all other HTML tags
In HTML, what is the type attribute in t: describes the type of content for the linked document
In HTML, what is the mark element?: An element used to highlight text
In HTML, which description is NOT an app: used to place emphasis on a word or span of text
In HTML, what is an aside element?: An HTML element typically used for sidebar information
What is a character entity?: Code used to display reserved HTML characters on the page.
In HTML, what is the caption tag in a ta: An element used to create captions for a table
In HTML, what is the semantic meaning be: span of text that represents a change in mood or quality of text
What is an HTML 5 boilerplate?: block of code you use as a starter template for any HTML document

In HTML, what are meta tags?: defines metadata for the HTML document
In HTML, what is a colspan attribute in: Represents the number of columns a cell should span in a table
